Batch scrape with empty batch_urls array returns error

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import batch_scrape, create_engine
from crawlberg import CrawlError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        engine = create_engine(None)
        urls = []
        await batch_scrape(engine, urls)
    except CrawlError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
